name: Claude Agent Sdk Go
headline: unofficial Go SDK for Claude integration
short_description: The claude-agent-sdk-go is an unofficial Go SDK for integrating Claude Code CLI into Go applications. It enables developers to build agentic AI workflows using Claude's capabilities. This SDK is useful for operations teams looking to automate tasks and integrate AI agents into their existing Go-based systems.
author: severity1

sections.overview:
The claude-agent-sdk-go is an unofficial Go SDK that enables developers to integrate Claude Code CLI into Go applications and build production-ready agentic AI workflows. It provides two powerful APIs: a Query API for one-shot operations and automation tasks, and a Client API for interactive multi-turn conversations with streaming responses. The SDK includes automatic resource management through the WithClient context manager pattern, session management for maintaining conversation state, and built-in tool integration for file operations, AWS, GitHub, and databases. Developers can leverage Claude's advanced code understanding and secure file operations while maintaining Go-idiomatic design patterns and comprehensive error handling.
CI/CD automation and scripting tasks with Claude's code understanding
Building interactive multi-turn conversational AI agents in Go applications
Integrating Claude's tool capabilities for database queries and AWS operations
Operations teams automating infrastructure tasks with AI-powered agents
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/severity1/claude-agent-sdk-go`
requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
